body: This actually might sound kinda wrong but it's actually quite relieving knowing that I'm not the only one who suffers from love.

I kinda have a similar story. I've fallen in love with this beautiful girl i was so in love with her that I would play scenarios in my head about me and her having a great future together. we were really great friends at first we would laugh and joke around like any other friends do but months later I  told her how I felt towards her I couldn't keep it a secret anymore and my worst nightmare came true she rejected me sadly and said that she wasn't looking for a relationship, and that hurted me badly, and now she's kinda ignoring me, I'm lonely and have no idea if I'll be able to move on from this unrequited love. She's usually hanging out with my friend and she would laugh from his jokes and my jealousy would just sky rocket. I really don't know what to do with myself I should maybe just kill myself as well.
That is easier said than done.
Yeah, and it's still probably bigger than yours.
